message.content: The decision to notify both the supervisory authority and the data subjects has been made based on a severity score of 3.5 (high) [F02][F05][F04]. This determination follows GDPR Article 33(1) and Article 34(1) due to the high risk to rights and freedoms [F02][F05][F04]. The breach involved 1,200 records containing address, benefit type, name, and PESEL sent unencrypted to an unknown recipient [F03][F02][F05][F04]. No mitigations were recorded at the time of assessment [F06].
